title: The legacy of caudillismo
goal: Read what the caudillos left behind, and use resultar with an adjective to say what turned out to be difficult, useful or dangerous.

items: Use *resultar* + adjective to say what turned out to be difficult, useful or dangerous.
Say what happened to national armies and governments after the caudillos.
Say why it was difficult to create strong institutions.
Say what historians think about the legacy of personal power.
Use the key words of this lesson: national, political, military, patronage, to replace and democracy.
